realm.name: TENANT_ADMIN
realm.description: Full administrative access within one tenant

clients.name: dms-core (Admin API client)
clients.description: Confidential client used server-to-server by dms-core to call the Keycloak Admin REST API (create/disable users, assign realm roles). Not used for interactive login. NOTE: 'secret' below is a LOCAL DEV placeholder only - a Keycloak realm import cannot read from OpenBao at import time, so this value must stay identical to KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET in infra/secrets/dms-core.secrets.(enc.)env (see scripts/openbao-encrypt-secrets.sh / openbao-decrypt-secrets.sh). For any shared or production realm, do NOT rely on this static value - instead import without a client secret and rotate it post-import via 'kcadm.sh update' (same pattern bootstrap.sh already uses for the manage-users role grant), sourcing the new value from OpenBao.

clients.name: Oak DMS Web Client
clients.description: Public client used by the frontend (SPA) for the Authorization Code + PKCE login flow.

clientScopes.name: oak-dms-tenant
clientScopes.description: Adds the tenant_id user attribute into the access token as the tenant_id claim.
